name: syns
description: Pull on Codex session start and sync on every turn-stop, continuing the agent only when a resolution is required, plus syns-init to build or join an agent-readable repository.

interface.shortDescription: Build or join a Syns repository; pull on start, sync on Stop.
interface.longDescription: Includes the syns-init skill for digest-bound local proposal and evaluation before adoption, plus lifecycle hooks that pull a joined Syns repository on startup/resume and sync it on every turn-stop, continuing the turn only when a resolution is required. Bundled hooks require trust, and changed hooks must be trusted again.
